title: The 4 Best Fitness Trackers Under $150
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for fitness trackers under $150, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at fitness trackers under $150 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Fitbit Charge 6 Fitness Tracker
products.blurb: Key specs: Built-in GPS, Google Maps and Wallet integration, 40+ exercise modes with auto recognition.
strengths: Built-in GPS is the standout feature that separates it from budget trackers entirely
Google Wallet lets you tap to pay for coffee mid-run without carrying a phone or card
Automatic exercise recognition catches walks and runs without manually starting a session
Most polished companion app of any tracker in this price range
limitations: Most advanced insights, Daily Readiness Score and deep sleep analysis, require Fitbit Premium
GPS use drops battery life from 7 days down to 5-6 hours of active tracking

products.name: Garmin Vivosmart 5
products.blurb: Key specs: Body Battery energy monitoring, Pulse Ox overnight tracking, Connected GPS via phone.
strengths: Full feature set unlocked at purchase, with zero ongoing subscription cost
Body Battery is a genuinely useful daily energy and recovery number few competitors match
Comfortable, low-profile design suited to both workouts and all-day wear
limitations: No built-in GPS, so accurate route tracking requires carrying a phone
Touchscreen navigation takes some getting used to compared to physical buttons
Smaller overall ecosystem of connected apps than Fitbit or Garmin's own watch lineup

products.name: Garmin vivofit 4 Activity Tracker
strengths: 1+ year battery life with no charging
Simple step, sleep and activity tracking

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
